patterns.message: web client code may import only @app-template/packages/ui and its generated client: it ships to the browser (decisions.md › The API contract in the api; Guards are configuration)

a module contract imports no workspace but @app-template/packages/schema, for the id schema, and no @effect/* package: every consumer of the module reads it (decisions.md › Module contracts; Guards are configuration)

a module contract re-exports its module's domain files by name, its ids, models with their errors and the state group a wire shape reads, never a policy or a move group, nor the domain's index, which brings them too, nor the module's entry, services or infrastructure, which load the data layer: every consumer of the module reads it (decisions.md › Module contracts)

a module's domain is pure: it imports no workspace but another module's contract, @app-template/application/<module>/contract, never its entry, which loads its services and the data layer, and @app-template/packages/schema, for the id schema; never the kernel, whose data layer would bring the backend into every importer of a model, so a model declares its values itself; and no @effect/* package; its tests add test support, a module's /testing, @app-template/packages/testing and @effect/vitest (decisions.md › A module's layers; Checks kept in the tables; Module contracts; Guards are configuration)
a module's domain imports neither its services nor its infrastructure (decisions.md › A module's layers)

the API contract declares its groups over the modules' contracts: it imports no workspace but a module's contract, @app-template/application/<module>/contract, never a module's entry, which loads its services and the data layer, no use case, no kernel part, no package and no @effect/* package, so whatever imports it loads no client or store (decisions.md › The API contract in the api; Module contracts)

a module's services import no workspace but @app-template/packages/schema for the codecs and the id generator, the transaction of @app-template/packages/db, the data layer's stores (@app-template/kernel/data) and another module's entry, and no @effect/* package: no use case, no test support, nothing that connects to the environment such as @app-template/kernel/aws, @app-template/kernel/llm or @app-template/packages/queue, which a module's infrastructure holds (decisions.md › A module's layers; Module contracts; Use cases above the modules; The language model in the kernel; Guards are configuration)
of @app-template/packages/db a module's services take only Transaction, to commit the writes of several statements in one transaction, a savepoint inside a caller's (decisions.md › A module's layers)

of @app-template/kernel/data a module's services take only the stores: the client Db, the relations and the migrations folder are the data layer's own (decisions.md › A module's layers; The data at the centre)
a module's services reach its infrastructure only through a port; the chat's ask, reply and title services have overrides of their own (decisions.md › A module's layers; Jobs as queue messages)

only the apps read the API contract, @app-template/application/http-api: a module's services and infrastructure and the use cases return models and fail with the domain's errors, which the api serves as they are (decisions.md › HTTP outside the modules; The API contract in the api)

a module's services' tests import the workspaces the services do and test support: the /testing of those and of @app-template/packages/queue, @app-template/packages/testing, @effect/vitest and @effect/platform-bun; no use case, nothing else that connects to the environment (decisions.md › A module's layers; Module contracts; Use cases above the modules; Guards are configuration)
